This API operation retrieves rendered PDF versions of reports from Grafana. When invoked with a GET request to the /reports/render/pdfs endpoint, it allows users to access pre-generated or on-demand PDF renderings of Grafana reports, which typically contain dashboards, panels, and visualizations. The operation is useful for exporting report data in a portable, shareable format that can be distributed to stakeholders or archived for record-keeping purposes.
